The patient’s agitation, aggression, and craving for medication suggest a hyperdopaminergic state, most consistent with stimulant intoxication/withdrawal or a psychotic/excited delirium picture driven by excessive dopamine signaling (especially mesolimbic pathways). Their insistence that “bad things will happen” without medication also points to intense craving/dependence, which is linked to elevated or dysregulated dopamine in reward circuits.  
CONFIDENCE: 55
